job.title: Fleet Mechanic
job.description:
Disclaimer: SLB completed the acquisition of ChampionX on July 16, 2025. If selected for this position, your employment will begin with ChampionX and will transition to SLB as part of the planned integration.

We have an immediate need for a Mobile Fleet Mechanic located in Odessa, TX.  This position is primarily responsible for providing maintenance of any type of heavy duty vehicle used to deliver chemicals to customers, plants, and/or warehouse locations. This is your opportunity to join a large growing company offering a competitive base hourly rate and benefits.   

  

What’s in it For You:  

  • You will join a growing company offering competitive pay and benefits  

  • Access to best-in-class resources, tools, and technology  

  • Opportunity for a long term, advanced career path  

  • A culture that values safety first, including training and personal protection  

  • Comprehensive benefits package (Medical, Dental, Vision, 401K and much more) that starts Day 1  

  

What You Will Do:  

  • Servicing all types of delivery and treating trucks.  

  • Inspect all heavy duty vehicles once a month  

  • Perform scheduled maintenance on all delivery vehicles  

  • Perform field repairs as needed  

  • Take part in planning and scheduling repairs in daily ops meeting  

  • Maintain ChampionX policy inspection maintenance records  

  • Keeps current on safety techniques and take advantage of all opportunities to improve driving and safety skills  

  • Recognize and avoid safety hazards in the work environment  

  • Assist in any emergency that may need mechanical knowledge  

  • Ensure equipment is safe and in proper working order including scheduling of preventative maintenance  

  • Adhere to company policies and follow Standard Operating Procedure per job task  

  • Wear required personal protection equipment (PPE) at all times during job tasks  

  • Ensure a safe work environment, promote a safety culture, and deliver safety training (weekly), etc.  

  • Manage all fleet equipment and maintenance needs  

  • Directing all fleet mechanics and maintenance activities to ensure all repair and maintenance work is performed safely, efficiently, and timely.  

  • Managing monthly OPEX on repair and maintenance  

  • Manage and perform inventory tasks  

  • Ensure all partners in the supply chain are working effectively and efficiently to ensure smooth operations and maintenance.  

   

Position Details:  

  • This position will be based in Odessa, TX. Will require possible travel to locations in the field for repairs.    

   

Minimum Qualifications:  

  • Minimum high school graduate or GED  

  • 2 years diesel mechanic experience  

  • Acceptable motor vehicle record (3 years)  

  • Immigration sponsorship not offered for this role  

   

Physical Demands  

  • Must be able to lift and carry a minimum of 50 lbs.  

  • Role is deemed safety-sensitive and may be subject to employer or customer drug testing  

   

Preferred Qualifications:  

  • 5 years diesel mechanic experience  

  • Chemical pump and plumbing knowledge   

  • Knowledge of vehicle electrical, hydraulic, and chassis systems  

  • Have certifications in brake, CVSA, and A/C systems  

  • Knowledge of use of diagnostic software (ADOC, INSITE)  

  • Experience working on hydraulic pumps, and PTO  

  • Awareness of chemical safety and the measures to take in the event of skin contact or spill  

  • Class A or B Commercial Driver’s License (CDL), issued by the state in which the candidate resides with all the relevant endorsements (X – Hazmat & Tanker)

job.title: Assistant Plant Operator
job.description:
Disclaimer: SLB completed the acquisition of ChampionX on July 16, 2025. If selected for this position, your employment will begin with ChampionX and will transition to SLB as part of the planned integration.

ChampionX has an immediate need for an Assistant Process Operator in our Chemical Technologies group located in Odessa, TX.  This position will join the production team in the Odessa plant and allow you to learn and progress through all operational skills required to blend, react, and packaging areas of the plant.  Reports to the Production Team leads with interaction of other core functional groups in the Odessa ChampionX Manufacturing Plant.

 

If you are a dedicated professional with a proven track record of success, we invite you to apply. This is your opportunity to join a large growing company offering competitive base rates and benefits. dedicated professional with a proven track record of success we invite you to apply. This is your opportunity to join a large growing company offering competitive base rates and benefits.

 

What’s in it For You:

  • The ability to make an impact and shape your career with a company that is passionate about growth
  • The support of an organization that believes it is vital to include and engage diverse people, perspectives, and ideas to achieve our best
  • Thrive in a company that values sustainability, and drives a safety-focused culture
  • Comprehensive benefits package starting day 1 of employment- medical, dental, vision, matching 401k, and more!

 

What You Will Do:

  • Complete work functions within production operations on a daily basis.
  • Responsible for quality blending of finished products and the bulk, drum and packaging of products.
  • General forklift duties required.
  • Core responsibility for blending and packaging of products demands the use of mechanical and electrical equipment such as pump, mixing equipment and automation control systems.
  • Completion and compliance of all safety initiatives and certification requirements including all near miss and incident reporting.
  • Accountable for data entry of production tickets, good receipts and shipping documentation.
  • Daily inspection of work area and monthly document reporting.
  • Daily housekeeping to ensure a clean and organized work environment is maintained at all times.
  • Assist with physical inventory counts and processes.
  • Compliance with all applicable ISO requirements.

 

Minimum Requirements:

  • High School Diploma or GED
  • Must be medically qualified to wear a respirator.
  • Physically able to lift 60 pounds, climb stairs or a ladder, and agile enough to squat and bend over (Agility Tests 1, 2a & 2b).
  • Immigration Sponsorship not offered for this role

 

Preferred Qualification:

  • Team player with ability to perform physical work.
  • Basic computer skills with the ability to navigate core programs.
  • Two year process technology degree a plus.
  • Minimum of 1 years' experience as an operator in a batch or specialty chemicals manufacturing plant.
  • Minimum of 1 year of relevant experience
  • Forklift operation certified
  • 24 hours Hazwoper certification

job.title: Local HazMat CDL Driver
job.description:
Disclaimer: SLB completed the acquisition of ChampionX on July 16, 2025. If selected for this position, your employment will begin with ChampionX and will transition to SLB as part of the planned integration.

We have an immediate need for an Operational Specialist in McCook, Nebraska.  If you are a dedicated DOT driving professional with a proven track record of success in customer delivery, we invite you to apply.  This is your opportunity to join a large growing company offering a competitive base hourly rate and benefits. 

What's in it For You:

  • You will join a growing company offering competitive pay and benefits
  • Access to best in class resources, tools, and technology
  • Opportunity for a long term, advanced career path
  • A culture that values safety first, including training and personal protection
  • Comprehensive benefits package (Medical, Dental, Vision, 401K and much more) that starts Day 1
  • $4,000 Hiring Bonus

What You Will Do:

This position will primarily be responsible for providing chemical treatments to oil wells, and the maintenance and safe operation of any type of vehicle used to deliver chemicals to customers, plants and/or warehouse locations.

  • Chemical treating of all scheduled wells and locations on a regular basis
  • Maintain chemical inventory reports
  • Present a professional manner and work closely with salespeople to satisfy customer requirements.
  • Maintain regular communication with sales and supervisor in order to report field problems and/or safety hazards
  • Maintain truck and equipment in a safe and operable condition by performing daily and periodic mechanical and safety inspections
  • Maintain driver's hours of service by using Turnpike and/or paper logbook reporting
  • Keeps current on safety techniques and take advantage of all opportunities to improve driving and safety skills
  • Recognize and avoid safety hazards in the work environment
  • Properly load trucks, prepare daily bills of lading, schedule the order of daily treatments and submit treating reports to sales

Territory / Location Information:

  • This will be a local position that will be based in and will be responsible for chemical treatment and delivery within a 50-mile radius of McCook, NE
  • Candidate must reside within 50 miles of McCook, NE
  • Relief positions also available with a $2.00 an hour travel bonus

Schedule:

  • Multiple Schedules available
  • Monday Thru Friday with an occasional Saturday
  • Weekend rotation availability with days off in the week
  • 10-12 hour day time shifts

Basic/Minimum Qualifications:

  • Minimum high school graduate or GED
  • Must be 21 years of age or older to operate company vehicle
  • Must currently hold a valid Class A or B Commercial Driver's License (CDL), issued by the state in which the candidate resides
  • Must have HazMat and Tanker Endorsements or be willing to be obtain within 30 days
  • One (1) year of commercial driving experience, compliant with Federal Motor Carrier Safety Regulations and DOT regulations, within the past three years required
  • Acceptable motor vehicle record (3 years)
  • All candidates must have the ability to speak, read and write English
  • Immigration sponsorship is not offered for this role
  • Must be comfortable working with cameras in the truck cab
  • No manual transmission restrictions

Physical Demands:

  • Must have the ability to Lift/Carry up to 50 pounds chest high.
  • Must be able to pass a drug screen and physical exam

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Three (3) years commercial driving experience, compliant with Federal Motor Carrier Safety Regulations and DOT regulations, within the past five years required
  • Experience with the operation of forklifts, drum dollies, trailer hoists, chemical pumps, hoses, meters, printers and gauges
  • Experience with handling products in various types of packages including bulk, drums, Porta-Feeds and mini/micro-feed units
  • Knowledge of precautions needed if exposed to H2S (hydrogen sulfide)
  • Experience in customer relations
  • Experience performing warehouse duties, which include preventative maintenance, inventory and ordering of chemicals, receiving incoming shipments, organizing warehouse for safe and efficient chemical storage, operation of customized chemical manufacturing equipment and the upkeep of warehouse grounds
  • Awareness of chemical safety and the measures to take in the event of skin contact or spill

Position Compensation and Benefits

  • Comprehensive benefits package that includes medical, dental, vision, 401(k) with company matching and more!
  • Hourly and overtime pay earning potential between $75,000 to $95,000 a year!

job.description:
isclaimer: SLB completed the acquisition of ChampionX on July 16, 2025. If selected for this position, your employment will begin with ChampionX and will transition to SLB as part of the planned integration.

Job Posting Description

ChampionX has immediate and future needs for a Chemical Service Technician located in Baker, MT. If you are a strong operation professional with a proven track record of success working in oilfield, we invite you to apply.  This is your opportunity to join a large growing company offering a competitive base salary and benefits.

  • Access to best-in-class resources, tools, and technology
  • Opportunity for a long term, advanced career path

job.title: Warehouse Specialist
job.description:
Disclaimer: SLB completed the acquisition of ChampionX on July 16, 2025. If selected for this position, your employment will begin with ChampionX and will transition to SLB as part of the planned integration.

ChampionX has an immediate need for a Warehouse Specialist located in Williston, ND. If you are a dedicated warehouse operator with a proven track record of success in logistics, we invite you to apply.  This is your opportunity to join a large growing company offering a competitive base hourly rate and benefits. 

What’s in it For You:

·       Access to best-in-class resources, tools, and technology

·       Grow your income as you drive growth

·       Thrive in a company that values a culture of safety to include top-notch safety training and personal protection equipment

·       Comprehensive benefits package starting day 1 of employment- medical, dental, vision, matching 401k and more 

·   Compensation: $24-$26/hr with overtime opportunities.

What You Will Do:

This position will primarily be responsible for loading/unloading products leaving from or arriving at warehouse locations.

·       Report to and receive instructions from the Field Operations Manager

·       Operate necessary equipment such as pumps, mules, forklifts, loading platforms

·       Responsible for making proper hookups from storage tanks to trucks and ensuring the correct chemical is loaded

·       Keep safety areas clear and maintain good housekeeping

·       Load/unload trucks containing drums, bulk totes, and other packaged products

·       Responsible for the sampling of chemicals and related paperwork

·       Perform daily inspection on all equipment used

·       Maintain and monitor in-house mixed chemical bulk totes

·       Pick and stage orders for all upcoming shipments

Basic Qualifications:

·       Minimum high school graduate or GED​

·  Must have a clean MVR

·       No immigration sponsorship offered for this position

·       Must be able to speak, read, and write English

Physical Demands:

·       Must be able to lift and carry a minimum of 50 lbs.

·       Role is deemed safety sensitive and may be subject to employer or customer drug testing

Preferred Qualifications:

·       3 years of experience working in a similar chemical environment

·       Experience with handling products in various types of packages including bulk, drums, bulk totes and mini/micro-feed units

·       Experience performing warehouse duties, which include preventative maintenance duties, inventory and ordering of chemicals, receiving incoming shipments, organizing warehouse for safe and efficient chemical storage, operation of customized chemical manufacturing equipment and the upkeep of warehouse grounds

·       Knowledge of pumps, valves, hand tools, and welding equipment

·       Awareness of chemical safety and the measures to take in the event of skin contact or spill

·       Proficiency with basic Math

·       Basic knowledge of personal computers and Windows software

·       Experience with SAP

job.title: Shop Technician - Gas Lift
job.description:
Disclaimer: SLB completed the acquisition of ChampionX on July 16, 2025. If selected for this position, your employment will begin with ChampionX and will transition to SLB as part of the planned integration.

We are looking for a Gas Lift Shop Technician located in Odessa, TX. This is your opportunity to join a global technology company, driving energy innovation for a balanced planet.

What’s In It For You:

  • First shift generally starts at 5:00 am and may be 8, 10 or 12 hours depending on the workload (with some weekend overtime as needed)

  • Thrive in a company that values safety and continuous improvement and encourages career growth

  • Comprehensive benefits package that includes medical, dental, vision, 401(k) with company matching and more!

What You Will Do:

  • Attend to breakdowns, diagnose faults, and oversee equipment improvements and time critical repairs; maintain preventative maintenance and breakdown report and part usage records; investigate the root cause and recommend course of action.

  • Assists shop on problem identification, trouble shooting and equipment issue resolution and repair. Evaluate non-conforming products to determine appropriate requirements to rework, repair, or scrap items.

  • Oversee spare parts inventory and may use a computerized maintenance management system.

  • Coordinate and direct contractors for specialized repairs and installations; maintain good working relations with internal customers and contractors.

  • Maintain toolkit, supplies, and requisite tool inventory.

  • Conduct facility and equipment inspections as a part of the Emergency Response Procedures.

  • Lead and implement Lean 5S + 1 project as a role model.

  • Know and comply with all safety policies and procedures.

  • Utilize hand or power tools and heavy equipment, such as, forklifts and pallet jacks in a safe, reliable manner.

  • Assist with inventory counts of current stock levels to identify potential shortages or excesses.

  • Complete inspections, repair of parts and routine maintenance on capillary trailers.

  • Deliver parts to technicians on job sites.

Pre-Employment requirements

  • Drug screen

  • Background Check

  • Motor Vehicle Check

Minimum Qualifications:  

  • High school diploma or GED

  • 2 years of mechanical shop experience

  • Valid drivers license

  • This safety-sensitive role may be subject to employer or customer drug testing

  • Read, understand and speak English

  • Must be willing to work overtime and Saturdays as required


 

Physical Demands:

  • The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job.

  • Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

  • Medium work:  Exerting up to 50 pounds of force occasionally and/or up to 20 pounds of force frequently, and/or up to 10 pounds of force constantly to move objects.

  • Requires Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) such as safety shoes and safety glasses

  • May stand, walk, stoop, sit, bend, twist, grasp, lift, climb,  

  • Requires visual and hearing acuity

  • Work primarily occurs in a heated and air-conditioned manufacturing environment

  • Hazards include proximity to moving mechanical parts, moving vehicles, electrical current or exposure to chemicals

  • Atmospheric conditions that affect the respiratory system or skin may include fumes, odors, dust, mists, gases, or poor ventilation

  • Potential skin exposure to oils and other cutting fluids

job.title: Chemist
job.description:
Disclaimer: SLB completed the acquisition of ChampionX on July 16, 2025. If selected for this position, your employment will begin with ChampionX and will transition to SLB as part of the planned integration.

ChampionX has a need for Chemist located in KL, Malaysia. This is your opportunity to join a growing company offering a competitive base salary and benefits.

As a Chemist at ChampionX, you will play a crucial role in the development, optimization and application of production chemical solutions to Oil and Gas customers. You will be responsible for running technical projects, conducting research, development, and coming up with technical solutions to address our customer’s challenges. You will work on projects both in the laboratory and in the field. As part of the role, you may be required to travel to different sites to conduct testing or meet with internal or external customers to discuss technical topics. The role will also allow the opportunity to present novel research or technical developments in conferences or industry events.

What You Will Do:
• Assist with Technical Support, Product Development and Selection.
• Conduct laboratory testing to develop, select or evaluate product performance, secondary properties and compatibilities. Prepare technical reports on the completed lab work.
• Support field-based projects. This may include troubleshooting of chemical related issues, conducting product selection and evaluation, and/or executing field trials.
• Collaborate with cross-functional teams regionally and globally on technical projects, roll-out new developments and/or optimize internal processes.
• Implement and follow the company’s safety policy (Goal Zero) and procedures. Update laboratory test procedures and safety related documents where necessary.
• Support the maintenance of the day-to-day operations in the laboratory. Ensure equipment is calibrated and maintained.
• Take a professional approach to self-development. Identify appropriate training opportunities.
• Any other task that may reasonably be requested.

Desired Competencies:
• Readily learns and adopts new technologies
• Asks the right questions to analyse situations
• Takes on challenges of unfamiliar tasks and learns from experiences
 

Education and Experience:
Degree or Advanced degree in Chemistry, Chemical Engineering or related discipline.
Job Requirements:
• Primarily laboratory and office based
• Field work will be required
• Ability to travel overseas

Desirable Education and Experience:
• Previous experience of working with oilfield chemical related projects
• Previous experience of working in a laboratory
• Previous experience of managing day-to-day projects
• Good computer skills, must have experience in Microsoft Word, Excel, PowerPoint
• Good oral and written communication skills, speak and write English


Physical Requirements:
May require long periods of standing conducting experiments in a laboratory or travel to visit the field

About ChampionX:
ChampionX, provides specialty chemistry programs and related services for upstream and midstream oil and gas operations looking to maximize production, protect assets and reduce operating costs and environmental impact. Through on-site problem solving and innovative technologies, our team provides solutions that help energy customers overcome complex challenges in the world’s toughest energy frontiers.

ChampionX (SLB) has an immediate need for a Regional Sales Manager - South Texas Region. This person will need to be within located a 60 mile radius of Kennedy, TX. This is your opportunity to join a global technology company, driving energy innovation for a balanced planet.

What’s in it For You:

  • The ability to make an impact and shape your career with a company that is passionate about growth.

  • The support of an organization that believes it is vital to include and engage diverse people, perspectives, and ideas to achieve our best.

  • Thrive in a company that values sustainability, drives a safety-focused culture and empowers through continuous improvement.

  • The chance to join a learning and problem-solving culture

  • Comprehensive benefits package that includes medical, dental, vision, 401(k) with company matching and more!

What You Will Do:

Sales Strategy and Planning

  • Effectively develop and execute strategic regional sales plans for chemical injection pumps within the South Texas Region, with focus on the Kennedy, Texas territory
  • Evaluate and implement appropriate sales techniques to support the strategic growth objectives while maintaining a profitable gross margin & repeatable sales revenues
  • Manage sales, profit margins and operational expenses for designated sales territory
  • Develop and update reliable sales forecasts
  • Identify, qualify, and convert project and new customer sales opportunities that will contribute to the territory revenues
  • Develop install base in adjacent segments to diversify market share in other regions outside of O&G
  • Provide periodic sales activity report

Customer Relationship Management

  • Set-up customer appointments to conduct sales presentations to promote, sell, and apply our complete product line in a regional sales area
  • Manage assigned accounts as well as developing new accounts, projects, or other sales opportunities
  • Provide product training at the field and corporate levels for all customer types
  • Provide customers with technical support and expertise in reviewing specifications and applying the products
  • Attend relevant product conventions, sales seminars, and tradeshows

Market Analysis

  • Develop annual marketing strategy in conjunction with the Director of Sales and the inside sales team
  • Identify joint marketing opportunities where applicable
  • Perform market assessments, competitor analyses, pricing strategies and execute counter strategies to gain market share
  • Draw conclusions from market assessment data on the competitive environment and the company’s strengths, weaknesses, opportunities, and targets

Collaboration

  • Develop relationships with internal sales teams, leverage synergies and drive joint sales opportunities
  • Collaborate and provide performance feedback to Manufacture Representatives/Distributors for the area of responsibility
  • Communicate with the Sales Team and the Production Team regularly to guarantee that sales and client objectives are met

Position Details:

  • Candidate must reside in San Antonio, TX or surrounding areas
  • Route territory will be the South Texas Region
  • Compensation package offered: Competitive base salary with eligibility for a quarterly sales incentive bonus plan
  • New hire product training, new hire onboarding and orientation provided
  • Plant visits will consist of office and cubicle environments in a manufacturing facility with PPE requirements
  • Immigration is not offered for this position

Minimum Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree in mechanical engineering, business, or equivalent experience.
  • 3 – 5 years of experience in customer-facing, outside sales of oil and gas
  • Willingness to travel up to 50-75% in the specified sales territory
  • Contract negotiation experience
  • Experience creating and presenting complex sales reports

Soft Skills:

  • Adapt at managing multiple tasks simultaneously
  • Results Oriented - Good follow up skills to ensure strategy implementation
  • Provide leadership through example and adequate direction
  • Able to communicate with customers at all levels
  • Able to build relationships with company and customer contacts
  • Professional and positive attitude
  • Passion for continuous improvement
  • Open to change and new information
  • Promote collaboration and share best practices towards the larger strategic business goals.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience working with chemical injection pumps
  • Experience with Automation
  • Technical expertise in oil and gas chemical injections pumps
  • Knowledge of Wellmark & Timberline products

​Physical Demands:

  • Role is deemed safety-sensitive and may be subject to employer or customer drug testing.
  • Minimal climbing stairs, lifting between 10lbs up to 25lbs, handling, grasping, turning, holding or using hands, dialing, standing, walking, hearing and writing
  • Occasional speaking between 11% and 33%
  • Constant use of a keyboard, mouse and viewing a computer monitor, sitting, and seeing greater than 66%

job.title: Field Operations Manager
job.description:
Job Description

Disclaimer: SLB completed the acquisition of ChampionX on July 16, 2025. If selected for this position, your employment will begin with

ChampionX and will transition to SLB as part of the planned integration.

The Field Operations Manager is responsible for overseeing transportation, logistics, and field operations to ensure efficient, cost-effective, and reliable service delivery. This role manages route planning, resource allocation, and supply chain coordination while maintaining control of operational expenses and ensuring alignment with customer requirements. The position serves as a key point of contact for clients, supporting account management and ensuring clear, responsive communication.

In addition to technical responsibilities, the Field Operations Manager leads a team of 10–30 employees across multiple shifts, driving performance through strong leadership, training, and ongoing coaching. This role emphasizes maintaining high standards for safety, compliance, and operational excellence, including auditing field practices and reinforcing safe work behaviors. The manager is also responsible for fostering team morale, addressing challenges, and promoting a positive work environment. Success in this role requires adaptability, strong organizational and problem-solving skills, and the ability to balance multiple priorities in a dynamic, fast-paced environment.

Minimum Education & Experience Requirements

  • Prior supervisory or people-leadership experience
  • Willingness and ability to travel as required
  • Valid driver’s license with an acceptable Motor Vehicle Record

Required Skills & Experience (Must – Haves)

  • Minimum of 5 years of experience in fleet, transportation, or logistics within the Oil & Gas services industry, third-party logistics, or a related field
  • At least 3 years of demonstrated supervisory or leadership experience
  • Ability and willingness to travel as needed to support business operations
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite and the ability to quickly learn and navigate internal business systems
  • Proven track record of professional ethics, effective time management, multitasking, adaptability, and self-motivation
  • Demonstrated excellent communication and organizational skills, with the ability to perform effectively in a fast-paced environment
  • Strong negotiation, decision-making, and problem-resolution capabilities
  • Valid driver’s license with an acceptable Motor Vehicle Record (MVR)
  • This position is not eligible for employment-based immigration sponsorship

Preferred Skills & Experience (Nice to Have)

  • Experience with related chemicals and logistics. routing, or third-party logistics
  • Oilfield experience
  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent combination of education and experience
  • Knowledge of route optimization and load scheduling best practices
  • Experience managing budgets, OPEX, and cost controls
  • Strong negotiation skills and experience working directly with customers

Job Duties:

  • Develop and optimize route planning and load scheduling for multi-stop deliveries to ensure efficiency and service reliability
  • Manage and monitor monthly operating expenses (OPEX) to maintain cost control and financial performance
  • Oversee and direct all transportation operations to ensure safe, timely, and compliant service delivery
  • Allocate, track, and document resources and operational movements to support accurate reporting and planning
  • Manage customer accounts, ensuring service expectations are met and strong relationships are maintained
  • Coordinate delivery scheduling through MRP systems and serve as a liaison between operations and customers
  • Ensure effective collaboration across the supply chain to maintain seamless and efficient operational workflows

job.title: Shipping/Receiving Coordinator (Temporary)
job.description:
Disclaimer: SLB completed the acquisition of ChampionX on July 16, 2025. If selected for this position, your employment will begin with ChampionX and will transition to SLB as part of the planned integration.

We are looking for a Temporary Shipping & Receiving Coordinator for our Rocky View, AB location.

The Shipping & Receiving Coordinator is responsible for receiving, inspecting, organizing, and shipping materials and fabricated equipment in a manufacturing/fabrication environment. This role requires familiarity with fabrication materials, the ability to review Material Test Reports (MTRs), strong organizational skills, and the ability to perform accurate transactions in SAP.

This is a temporary 1-year contract

What’s in it For You:

  • The ability to make an impact and shape your career with a company that is passionate about growth.

  • The support of an organization that believes it is vital to include and engage diverse people, perspectives, and ideas to achieve our best

  • Thrive in a company that values sustainability, drives a safety-focused culture and has been recognized as one of the most ethical companies in the world

What Will You Do:

  • Receive incoming materials and fabricated components, verifying quantities, condition, and documentation against purchase orders (POs).

  • Coordinate outbound shipments, including packaging, labeling, and scheduling with carriers.

  • Prepare standard shipping documentation such as packing lists, bills of lading, and USMCA documentation

  • Maintain organized warehouse, yard, and staging areas to support fabrication and shipment flow.

  • Review and verify Material Test Reports (MTRs) for completeness and alignment with received materials.

  • Confirm material traceability including heat numbers and material grades.

  • Work with QC and fabrication teams to resolve discrepancies related to materials or documentation.

  • Perform goods receipt, inventory movements, and shipment transactions in SAP.

  • Ensure all materials are received against the correct purchase orders and projects.

  • Track expected PO arrivals and communicate issues related to late, early, or incomplete deliveries.

  • Maintain accurate inventory records and support cycle counts as required.

  • Follow all site safety procedures related to material handling, lifting, and forklift operation.

  • Maintain a clean, safe, and orderly shipping and receiving area.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • High school diploma or equivalent.

  • 3-7 years of experience in shipping and receiving within a fabrication or manufacturing environment. Familiarity with fabrication materials such as steel, pipe, and industrial components.

  • Ability to review and understand Material Test Reports (MTRs).

  • Proficiency with SAP for receipts, inventory, and PO management.

  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.

  • Comfortable working in a shop environment.

  • Strong and clear communication skills.

  • Takes ownership of documentation and material accuracy.

Position Details:

  • Candidate must reside in Calgary or Rocky View, AB or the surrounding area.

  • This position is Monday to Friday on-site, based on 40 hours per week.

  • Immigration Sponsorship is not available for this role.

Physical Demands:

  • Ability to push, pull, lift and carry up to 50lbs

  • This role is a safety-sensitive position, and the successful candidate will be required to complete pre-employment testing in accordance with company policy.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Forklift certification or willingness to obtain.

job.title: RD&E Group Leader
job.description:
Disclaimer: SLB completed the acquisition of ChampionX on July 16, 2025. If selected for this position, your employment will begin with ChampionX and will transition to SLB as part of the planned integration.

We are searching for an RD&E Group Leader for our Diagnostic Solutions team located in Sugar Land, Texas.  As a Group Leader, you will align resources and prioritize projects amongst your team to ensure targets are met. You will act as a liaison with internal and external customers to define scopes of work and communicate project updates. The ideal candidate is highly versatile, communicates effectively, thrives in a collaborative environment, and has a strong track record of leading project teams to deliver technical solutions to complex problems. 

What's in it For You:

  • A flexible, independent work environment where you will manage a monthly schedule

  • Access to best-in-class resources, tools and technology

  • Thrive in a company that values a culture of safety to include top-notch safety training and personal protection equipment

  • Comprehensive benefits package that includes medical, dental, vision, a company-paid pension plan, tuition reimbursement and more!

What You Will Do:

In this role, as RD&E Group Leader for the Diagnostic Solutions team, your primary responsibility is assisting and enabling your teams to provide materials compatibility and analytical support for our customers and researchers. This is a leadership position, and the successful candidate will be responsible for the safety, quality, productivity and talent development of their teams.

Main responsibilities:

  • Provide leadership and technical expertise to the Materials Compatibility team and the Waters, Deposits, and Hydrocarbons Analytical team

  • Lead the team's technical effort under the guidance of the senior leadership, utilizing experience in fundamental science, oil field problem solving, chemical manufacturing/scale-up support, and project/people management

  • Ensure each associate performs duties in a safe and efficient manner, maintains quality standards, and continues to grow and develop expertise

  • Provide materials compatibility and analytical support for internal stakeholders and the company’s customers

  • Apply performance management guidelines for setting performance goals, evaluating and promoting career growth and development, conducting performance appraisals, and recommending salary and performance adjustments.

  • Collaborate with Sales, Marketing, and Technology teams to scope projects and identify needs/gaps to feed future projects

  • Work closely with team members to help ensure effective and efficient operations

  • Engage with key stakeholders to forecast sample and project demand to enable effective resource allocation to meet business timelines

  • Identify opportunities for third-party testing to reduce sample backlogs and expand testing capabilities as needed

  • Manage several projects at once while working within a fast-paced environment

  • Hire and train new team members as needed

Position Details: This position is located in Sugar Land, Texas.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Degree in analytical chemistry, materials science, polymer science or related scientific/technical discipline (required, and relevant experience including technology strategy development & implementation, leading & developing teams, and driving innovation. Education and experience should fall in one of the following levels:

    • Bachelors degree and 7 years experience; OR

    • Masters degree and 4 years experience; OR

    • PhD and 2 years experience

  • Five or more years of relevant experiences in management, technology development and innovation areas.

  • Requires track record of successful technology development and leveraging of external technology.

  • Ability to motivate individuals to operate as a part of a high-functioning team

  • Ability to travel up to 20%

Preferred Qualifications:

  • For the Materials Compatibility team, experience with at least one of the following techniques is highly desired: Tensile, Hardness, measurement of corrosion rates, high pressure (2000 psi), high temperature (500 °F) immersion testing, failure analysis, electrochemistry (critical pitting temperature and anodic cyclic polarization).

  • For the Waters, Deposits, and Hydrocarbons Analytical team, experience with common analytical techniques such as ICP, IC, XRF, XRD, SEM, and GC is highly desired.

  • Excellent time management skills

  • Excellent written, oral, and visual communication skills to communicate effectively with all levels of the organization, both within and outside the business

  • Previous supervisory experience is preferred

  • Experience with Specialty Chemicals in the Oil & Gas industry is preferred

  • Performed daily inventory cycle counts, investigated and resolved inventory discrepancies, and reported findings to management.

  • Received incoming parts, verified quantities and descriptions against vendor packing lists, and ensured accuracy before processing.

  • Used Oracle to receive inventory invoices, confirming quantities matched both the packing list and system records.

  • Used Apex to process parts requests from different branches, pull parts from inventory, packed and sealed shipments, and prepared orders using UPS or RXO.

  • Monitored inventory levels and restocked shelves to maintain adequate stock.

  • Completed weekly vendor runs to pick up parts.

  • Operated forklifts to safely load and unload freight trucks and move materials throughout the yard.

  • Maintained a clean, organized, and hazard-free work environment in compliance with safety standards.

Minimum Qualifications:  

  • High School education or equivalent

  • 2 years relevant experience managing inventory

  • Experience using Oracle or SAP

  • Ability to drive a forklift

  • Attention to detail

  • Good verbal and written communication skills

  • Basic computer skills, including Microsoft Office Suite

Physical Demands:

  • The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job.  Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

  • Role is deemed safety-sensitive and may be subject to employer or customer drug testing.

  • Medium work:  Exerting up to 50 pounds of force occasionally and/or up to 20 pounds of force frequently, and/or up to 10 pounds of force constantly to move objects.

  • Climbing:  Ascending or descending ladders, stairs, scaffolding, ramps, poles and the like, using feet and legs and/or hands and arms. Body agility is emphasized.

  • Balancing:  Maintaining body equilibrium to prevent falling when walking, standing, or crouching on narrow, slippery, or erratically moving surfaces.

  • Stooping:  Bending body downward and forward by bending spine at the waist. This factor is important if it occurs to a considerable degree and requires full use of the lower extremities and back muscles.

  • Kneeling:  Bending legs at knee to come to a rest on knees.

  • Crouching:  Bending the body downward and forward by bending leg and spine.

  • Crawling:  Moving about on hands and knees or hands and feet.

  • Reaching:  Extending hand(s) and arm(s) in any direction.

  • Walking:  Moving about on foot to accomplish tasks, particularly for long distances or moving from one work site to another.

  • Pushing:  Using upper extremities to press against something with steady force in order to thrust forward, downward, or outward.

  • Lifting:  Raising objects from a lower to a higher position or moving objects horizontally from position to position.

job.title: Field Production Chemist
job.description:
Job Posting Description

Disclaimer: SLB completed the acquisition of ChampionX on July 16, 2025. If selected for this position, your employment will begin with ChampionX and will transition to SLB as part of the planned integration.

We are looking for an experienced Field Production Chemist located in Anchorage, Alaska. This is your opportunity to join a global technology company, driving energy innovation for a balanced planet.

What’s in it For You:

  • Access to best-in-class resources, tools, and technology

  • Opportunity for a long term, advanced career path

  • A culture that values safety first, including training and personal protection

  • Comprehensive benefits package that includes medical, dental, vision, 401(k) with company matching and more!

What You Will Do:

Production Chemistry:

  • Monitor chemical programs at all North Slope facilities with a diverse background of technical knowledge and experience and focus on continuous improvement of current chemical applications.

  • Monitor separation efficiency at each facility and recommend chemical, procedural, and mechanical improvements to the processes. 

  • Monitor the chemistry of produced fluids, anticipate associated problems, and recommend best-in-class solutions.

  • Monitor facility utility systems and recommend required chemical maintenance.

  • Constantly work to remain experts in best-in-class chemical technology and application.

  • Act as the single point of contact (SPOC) for all production chemistry issues.

On-site Problem Solving:

  • Utilize pro-active problem-solving skills as production challenges become apparent.

Chemical Program Control:

  • Accountable for the implementation and execution of chemical programs. 

  • Support continuous improvement of the chemical programs with a focus on product development and testing.

  • Conduct daily coordination meetings to align field operations.

  • Perform site inspections and field tours to assess operational conditions.

  • Execute inventory audits at chemical injection points.

  • Monitor and regulate dosage levels at injection sites to ensure optimal performance.

  • Collect production fluid samples and perform laboratory testing for chemical treatment performance analysis.

  • Compile and submit comprehensive daily technical and economic performance reports

Communication & Account Management:

  • Maintain relationships and communicate with project manager, management, research and development, marketing, corrosion engineers, materials coordinator and the other production chemists.

  • Maintain relationships and communicate with key customer personnel.

  • Maintain relationships and communicate with operations, management, and engineering groups.

  • Maintain relationships and communicate with design groups and provide the required information to best utilize chemical management solutions.

  • Ensure North Slope contract requirements are met

  • Schedule and complete business reviews with key customer personnel

  • Train and develop field production chemistry team members

  • Act as leaders through actions and professionalism.

  • Support a culture of “Zero Defect” in HSE performance.

  • Drive business and technical performance improvements with the use of a performance management system.

  • Work within a multi-functional team that assesses the plant integrity via direct inspection, corrosion and process monitoring, and applies control measures through the deployment of corrosion and process chemicals.

  • Develop measures to maintain integrity through applied corrosion control techniques and repair.

  • Coordination of activities within the North Slope Production Chemistry team. Assist operations with implementation of the recommended chemical programs. 

  • Maintain in-depth knowledge of current and planned production facilities.

Position Details

  • Rotational schedule: 14 days on, 14 days off, 21 days on, 21 days off OR 28 days on, 28 days off

  • Individual can live anywhere within the United States, but must be able to travel to Anchorage, Alaska for duration of rotation

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in chemistry, Engineering (Chemical, Mechanical, Industrial), or Life Sciences (Biology, Chemistry, etc.) or related fields

  • 3 years of Chemical industry experience

  • Chemical Application knowledge and experience

  • Ability to travel within assigned sales territory

  • Must have a valid Driver’s License and acceptable Motor Vehicle Record

  • No immigration sponsorship offered for this role (US Only)

Physical Demands:

  • May be required to Lift/Push/Pull/Carry up to 55 pounds chest high.

  • Role is deemed safety-sensitive and may be subject to employer or customer drug testing

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Engineering (Chemical, Mechanical, Industrial), or Life Sciences (Biology, Chemistry, etc.)

  • 3+ years of successful technical sales or field sales support experience

  • Experience in oil and gas industry

What You Will Do:

  • Uses mastery of electrician trades skills and knowledge to diagnose and solve electrical problems and installation of Smarten Controllers and other related equipment.

  • Perform installation and repair of other I&E equipment, encompassing other lift types and products.

  • Creates and assembles components and installs them as required.

  • Performs preventative maintenance.

  • Documents maintenance and repairs as required.

  • Interacts fluently with those in other trades and work areas to complete work assignments; 

  • Contributes to the department continuous improvement culture.

  • Knows and complies with all safety policies and procedures.

  • Maintains a clean and well-organized work area.

  • Other duties as required.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • High school diploma or GED

  • 3 years of experience in Oil & Gas I&E, Automation

  • Direct SCADA installation and troubleshooting experience

  • Can perform moderately complex repairs and installs independently

  • Strong customer relations skills including the ability to explain and train

  • Knowledge of proper use of hand tools

  • Knowledge of wiring and control theory

  • Analytical and problem solving ability

  • Ability to follow prescribed company policies, procedures, and protocols for installation, service and equipment maintenance

  • Interact politely and professionally with customers and/or coworkers

  • Ability to effectively present information and respond to questions from managers, clients, and customers

  • Ability to effectively plan and organize

  • Follow all safety policies and company-wide safety requirements; encourage action assuring safe behavior; confront unsafe behavior and conditions proactively and positively

  • Work in excess of 8 hours per day and 40 hours per week, as required to meet business needs

  • Work in an unsupervised environment

  • Use a computer to communicate, create, and access data

  • Determine the priorities, goals, and objectives of work assigned

Physical Demands:

  • Role is deemed safety-sensitive and may be subject to employer or customer drug testing.

  • Medium work:  Exerting up to 50 pounds of force occasionally and/or up to 20 pounds of force frequently, and/or up to 10 pounds of force constantly to move objects.

  • Physical Activities

  • Climbing:  Ascending or descending ladders, stairs, scaffolding, ramps, poles, and the like, using feet and legs and/or hands and arms. Body agility is emphasized.

  • Balancing:  Maintaining body equilibrium to prevent falling when walking, standing, or crouching on narrow, slippery, or erratically moving surfaces.

  • Stooping:  Bending body downward and forward by bending spine at the waist. This factor is important if it occurs to a considerable degree and requires full use of the lower extremities and back muscles.

  • Kneeling:  Bending legs at knee to come to a rest on knees.

  • Crouching:  Bending the body downward and forward by bending leg and spine.

  • Crawling:  Moving about on hands and knees or hands and feet.

  • Reaching:  Extending hand(s) and arm(s) in any direction.

  • Walking:  Moving about on foot to accomplish tasks, particularly for long distances or moving from one work site to another.

  • Pushing:  Using upper extremities to press against something with steady force in order to thrust forward, downward, or outward.

  • Pulling:  Using upper extremities to exert force in order to draw, drag, haul, or tug objects in a sustained motion.

  • Lifting:  Raising objects from a lower to a higher position or moving objects horizontally from position to position.

  • Fingering:  Picking, pinching, typing, or otherwise working, primarily with fingers rather than the whole hand or arm as in handling.

  • Grasping:  Applying pressure to an object with the fingers and palm.

  • Feeling:  Perceiving attributes of objects, such as size, shape, temperature, or texture by touching with skin, particularly that of fingertips.

  • Talking:  Expressing or exchanging ideas by means of the spoken word.  Those activities in which they must convey detailed or important spoken instructions to customer or other workers accurately, loudly, or quickly.

  • Hearing:  Perceiving the nature of sounds at normal speaking levels with or without correction.  Ability to receive detailed information through oral communication, and to make the discriminations in sound.

  • Repetitive motion:  Substantial movement (motions) of the wrists, hands, and/or fingers to use a computer.

  • The employee is required to have close visual acuity to perform an activity such as: visual inspection involving small defects, small parts and/or operation of machines (including inspection), using measurement devices, and/or assembly or fabrication of parts at distances close to the eyes.

  • The employee is required to have visual acuity to operate motor vehicles.

  • The employee is required to have visual acuity to determine the accuracy, neatness, thoroughness of work assigned or to make general observations of facilities or structures.

  • Indoor and outdoor environmental conditions.  Activities occur indoors and outdoors.

  • Extreme heat.  Temperatures above 100 degrees for periods of more than one hour.  Consideration should be given to the effect of other environmental conditions, such as wind and humidity.

  • Hazards.  Includes a variety of physical conditions, such as proximity to moving mechanical parts, moving vehicles, electrical current or exposure to chemicals.

  • Atmospheric conditions.  One or more of the following conditions that affect the respiratory system or the skin:  fumes, odors, dust, mists, gases, or poor ventilation.

  • Oils. There is air and/or skin exposure to oils and other cutting fluids.

  • Preferred Qualifications

  • Apprentice Electrical License within a year of testing for Journeyman License

  • Direct experience with Gas Lift, and/or Chemical Injection automation

  • Direct experience commissioning and calibrating instrumentation equipment i.e. transmitters, transducers etc.

job.title: Senior Chemist
job.description:
Job Description

Disclaimer: SLB completed the acquisition of ChampionX on July 16, 2025. If selected for this position, your employment will begin with ChampionX and will transition to SLB as part of the planned integration.

This Senior Chemist position focuses on applying advanced chemical expertise to design and execute laboratory testing, analyze complex data, and support research and development activities. The role requires strong leadership, including opportunities to mentor junior chemists, guiding technical workstreams, and driving best practices in safety, quality, and efficiency, while managing a high-volume workload of up to 1,000 samples per month. Working closely with a small, collaborative team of two other chemists and reporting directly to the Regional Lab Manager, this individual must prioritize teamwork and effective communication to ensure project success. The ideal candidate brings 5+ years of laboratory experience, proven leadership ability, and strong problem-solving skills within a highly team-oriented environment.

The successful candidate will be a technically strong production chemist who thrives in a small-team environment, is comfortable managing a high-volume analytical workload, takes ownership of responsibilities, communicates effectively with customers and colleagues, and contributes positively to a collaborative and accountable laboratory culture.

Minimum Education & Experience Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in Chemistry or related field with at least 5 years of US Land oilfield production chemistry experience, or
  • Master's degree in Chemistry or related field with at least 3 years of US Land oilfield production chemistry experience
  • Demonstrated experience supporting production chemistry programs for U.S. land-based oil and gas operations.
  • Experience managing high volumes of routine analytical testing while maintaining quality, accuracy, and turnaround time expectations.
  • Proven ability to follow SOPs, work independently, prioritize competing demands, and manage moderately complex projects with minimal supervision.
  • Experience operating and troubleshooting ICP-OES, Ion Chromatography (IC), Gas Chromatography (GC), XRF, or equivalent analytical instrumentation.
  • Strong analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills with exceptional attention to detail.
  • Effective verbal and written communication skills with the ability to communicate technical information to both technical and non-technical audiences.

Required Skills & Experience (Must – Haves)

  • Demonstrated success working within a small laboratory team where collaboration, flexibility, and individual accountability are critical to overall laboratory performance.
  • Demonstrate initiative and ability to work independently and handle multiple tasks
  • Demonstrated ability to adapt to changing priorities while maintaining a strong commitment to safety, quality, and customer responsiveness.
  • Demonstrated desire and initiative to grow into leadership roles over time, including taking on increased responsibility, mentoring peers, and contributing to team development
  • Physically able to lift 50 pounds, climb stairs or ladder, and agile enough to squat and bend over
  • Ability to independently prioritize tasks, manage multiple projects, and meet deadlines with minimal supervision
  • Strong organizational skills and ability to manage a high-volume workload (handling up to 1,000 samples per month)

Preferred Skills & Experience (Nice to Have)

  • 5–10 years of experience in oilfield production chemistry, chemical manufacturing, or industrial analytical laboratory environments.
  •  3+ years of laboratory leadership, technical leadership, mentoring, or senior laboratory experience supporting production chemistry operations.
  •  Demonstrated history of taking ownership of laboratory responsibilities, following through on commitments, and consistently delivering high-quality results.
  • Proven ability to foster a collaborative, respectful, and solutions-oriented work environment through effective communication and constructive engagement with colleagues and stakeholders.
  • Experience presenting technical findings, managing projects, and collaborating effectively across functional teams.
  • Understanding of customer needs and ability to translate analytical data into actionable operational insights.
  • Experience identifying and implementing process improvements that enhance laboratory efficiency, quality, safety, or customer service.

Job Duties:

  • Lead and execute routine and non-routine analytical testing activities in support of customer programs, field operations, and laboratory service commitments.
  • Apply advanced production chemistry knowledge and sound technical judgment to troubleshoot challenges, validate methods, interpret analytical data, and solve complex problems.
  • Support customer programs by designing, conducting, and interpreting laboratory analyses tied to real-world field performance and operational outcomes.
  • Independently manage multiple priorities, project deadlines, customer requests, and stakeholder communications in a fast-paced laboratory environment.
  • Manage high volumes of routine analytical testing while maintaining quality, accuracy, data integrity, and turnaround time expectations.
  • Operate, maintain, troubleshoot, and optimize laboratory instrumentation while ensuring compliance with established QA/QC procedures and laboratory standards.
  • Support the mentoring, training, and development of chemists, technicians, and technologists through coaching, knowledge sharing, and technical guidance.
  • Collaborate with field personnel, sales, technical teams, and customers to translate analytical data into actionable recommendations.
  • Identify opportunities for process improvements that enhance laboratory efficiency, quality, safety, and customer service.
  • Champion safety culture, support continuous improvement initiatives, and contribute positively to overall laboratory performance, efficiency, and team effectiveness.
  • Perform miscellaneous administrative tasks.

balanced planet. As innovators, that’s been our mission for nearly a century.

job.title: Senior Chemist/ Engineer
job.description:
Disclaimer: SLB completed the acquisition of ChampionX on July 16, 2025. If selected for this position, your employment will begin with ChampionX and will transition to SLB as part of the planned integration.

We are seeking a highly motivated and detail-oriented Senior Chemist/ Engineer to support Pilot Plant operations in Sugar Land. This role plays a critical part in scaling new technologies from laboratory development to full-scale production. The successful candidate will combine hands-on chemistry, quality assurance experience, pilot plant operational support and project management to ensure product quality, process reliability, and safe execution of scale-up activities.

What’s in it for You

  • Opportunity to make a meaningful impact and shape your career in a growth-oriented organization

  • Work within a collaborative culture that values diverse perspectives and innovation

  • Be part of a company committed to sustainability and a strong safety-first culture

  • Comprehensive benefits starting day one: medical, dental, vision, 401(k) with match, and more

What You Will Do:

Quality Assurance & Analytical Support

  • Support the development, implementation, and continuous improvement of product quality control specifications, processes and procedures in collaboration with both RD&E and Pilot Plant process chemists and engineers

  • Manage and maintain quality data in SAP, including data entry and validation, generating reports, and performance tracking

  • Conduct chemical and physical analyses of raw materials, intermediates, and finished products to ensure compliance with internal quality specifications and regulatory standards during scale-up and production trials

Pilot Plant Scale-Up Support

  • Support pilot plant operations, including lab-scale and pilot-scale processes to transfer new products to a manufacturing plant for full-scale production

  • Evaluate incoming blend and reaction chemistry requests to identify and close gaps in raw material and/or intermediate availability at the pilot Plant utilizing SAP to set up and order these materials

  • Collaborate with process chemists and engineering teams to translate lab-scale chemistry into scalable and reproducible processes

  • Assess process engineering requirements for incoming blend and reaction chemistry requests to determine the feasibility of Pilot Plant support

  • Communicate with a variety of internal stakeholders (Sales, Marketing, Research, Supply Chain/ Manufacturing) to understand their needs and identify solutions

  • Communicate technical findings, data trends, and recommendations effectively through reports, presentations and recommended manufacturing procedures

Operational Excellence & Equipment Management

  • Maintain laboratory and pilot plant instrumentation through proper calibration, maintenance, and safe operation of analytical and process equipment to ensure reliability and readiness

  • Identify opportunities for process optimization and operational improvement

Cross-Functional Collaboration

Safety, Regulatory Compliance & Continuous Improvement

  • Adhere to all safety, environmental, and regulatory requirements, promoting a strong safety culture

  • Partner with corporate functions (RD&E, Supply Chain, Quality, and SHE teams) to investigate and resolve product quality and scale-up challenges

  • Participate in risk assessments, process safety reviews, and continuous improvement initiatives

  • Stay current with industry trends, regulatory changes, and best practices in both quality and process development

Minimum Qualifications

  • BS in Chemistry or Chemical Engineering or related field with three years of relevant work experience or MS with two years of relevant work experience

  • Hands-on experience with laboratory instrumentation and analytical techniques

  • Experience with quality control processes and data management

  • Familiarity with quality management systems or software

  • Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail

  • Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a team environment

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills

  • Commitment to safety and operational excellence

  • Strong ownership of quality systems and data integrity

  • Proactive troubleshooting and continuous improvement mindset

  • Effective collaboration across technical and operational teams

  • Ability to bridge bench level chemistry with pilot plant and full-scale operations

  • Situational Adaptability

  • Work at times under limited supervision and lead projects with limited scope and complexity

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in a pilot plant, process development, or scale-up environment

  • Knowledge of SAP for quality data management

  • Exposure to chemical processing techniques such as blend or reaction chemistry scale-up

  • Understanding of process safety and industrial chemical handling practices

job.title: Principal Chemist
job.description:
SLB has an immediate need for a highly motivated Principal Chemist in our New Product Development team located in Sugar Land, Texas. The Principal Chemist will support strategic innovation projects for Chemically Enhanced Oil Recovery and Production Enhancement. The Principal Chemist will also support manufacturing and supply chain to scale up products from lab to plant. The ideal candidate is highly versatile, communicates effectively, and thrives in a collaborative environment.

If you are a passionate professional that likes to work in an autonomous, hands-on environment, we invite you to apply. This is your opportunity to join a growing company offering a competitive base salary and benefits.

What’s in it For You:

  • The ability to make an impact and shape your career with a company that is passionate about growth.

  • The support of an organization that believes it is vital to include and engage diverse people, perspectives and ideas to achieve our best.

  • Thrive in a company that values sustainability, drives a safety-focused culture and has been recognized as one of the most ethical companies in the world.

  • Comprehensive benefits package starting day 1 of employment- medical, dental, vision, matching 401k, and more!

What You Will Do:

  • Perform work in a safe manner while identifying opportunities for continuous improvement.

  • Conduct applied scientific research aimed at solving complex problems related to Chemically Enhanced Oil Recovery.

  • Execute strategic innovation projects with possible global reach and high impact on the business.

  • Develop novel chemistries/formulations to meet customer needs

  • Develop new testing and/or dispensing methods.

  • Analyze research data and prepare detailed reports and presentations

  • Drive the continuous improvement of our business to responsibly deliver energy.

  • Communicate technical recommendations or test results to a wide range of audiences including internal and external customers

  • Work effectively in a team environment with cross-functional members.

  • Monitor and track state-of-the-art trends across assigned technical domains.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • MSc in Chemistry, Chemical Engineering, Materials Engineering or related fields with more than four years of relevant work experience or PhD with less than three years of work experience in Chemistry, Chemical Engineering, Materials Engineering or related fields.

  • Experience in organic synthesis and/or polymerization

  • Understanding of structure/properties relationship.

  • Knowledge of interfacial science (IFT, contact angle, surface tension)

  • Ability to work with business counterparts to support our customers and new technology adoption.

  • Ability to analyze and interpret incomplete information.

  • Ability to operate independently and as a part of a highly effective team.

  • Demonstrate expertise and breadth of knowledge to solve challenges where precedents typically do not exist

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Prior experience in latex polymerization reactions.

  • Experience in Enhanced Oil Recovery is a plus.

job.title: Maintenance Procurement Rep
job.description:
Disclaimer: SLB completed the acquisition of ChampionX on July 16, 2025. If selected for this position, your employment will begin with ChampionX and will transition to SLB as part of the planned integration.

We are looking for a Maintenance Procurement Representative located in Sugar Land, TX. This is your opportunity to join a global technology company, driving energy innovation for a balanced planet.

What's in it For You:

  • Access to best-in-class resources, tools, technology and continuous education
  • Thrive in a company that values a culture of safety to include top-notch safety training and personal protective equipment
  • The opportunity to make an impact and shape your career with a company that is passionate about growth
  • The support of an organization that believes it is vital to include and engage diverse people, perspectives and ideas to achieve our best

What You Will Do:

  • Create and manage purchase requisitions and purchase orders for maintenance materials, equipment, and contracted services
  • Obtain supplier quotations and support sourcing activities to ensure competitive pricing and timely procurement
  • Expedite critical materials to support maintenance schedules, production requirements, and plant reliability
  • Monitor purchase order status and resolve delivery issues to ensure material availability
  • Ensure procurement activities comply with company purchasing policies, procedures, and internal controls
  • Coordinate with maintenance planners, supervisors, technicians, and operations personnel to identify material requirements for preventive, corrective, and turnaround maintenance activities
  • Verify material availability for scheduled maintenance work and support emergency procurement efforts during equipment failures and unplanned outages
  • Assist in coordinating contractor services and maintenance-related projects

  • Assist with cycle counts, inventory audits, inventory optimization initiatives, and the reduction of obsolete inventory while maintaining critical spare coverage
  • Develop and maintain effective working relationships with suppliers and service providers while supporting supplier onboarding and qualification processes
  • Monitor supplier performance related to quality, cost, and delivery and coordinate resolution of supplier issues and discrepancies
  • Track maintenance procurement expenditures and assist with budget tracking, cost reporting, invoice reconciliation, and resolution of payment discrepancies
  • Maintain procurement records and documentation to support audits, regulatory compliance, and internal controls
  • Utilize SAP, GEP, and other business systems to process procurement transactions and maintain accurate purchasing information
  • Ensure compliance with company procurement, safety, environmental, and quality requirements
  • Work closely with Maintenance, Operations, Supply Chain, Finance, and external suppliers to support safe, efficient, and reliable plant operations

Position Details:

  • Location: Sugar Land, TX

  • Works under general supervision and is capable of making routine procurement decisions while following established purchasing policies and procedures
  • Serves as the primary liaison between Maintenance, Operations, Supply Chain, Finance, and external suppliers

Minimum Qualifications:

  • High School Diploma or GED required

  • Basic computer application literacy, including Microsoft Office with strong proficiency in Microsoft Excel
  • Experience using SAP, GEP, or other ERP/procurement systems preferred

Physical Demands:

  • May be required to lift, push, pull, and carry up to 25 pounds.
  • Ability to sit, stand, walk, and move throughout an office, warehouse, and manufacturing environment.
  • May occasionally be required to visit production and maintenance areas while wearing required personal protective equipment.
  • Ability to use a computer and other office equipment for extended periods.
  • Role is deemed safety-sensitive and may be subject to employer or customer drug testing.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Knowledge of Maintenance, Repair, and Operations (MRO) materials and maintenance procurement processes
  • Understanding of purchasing, inventory management, and supplier management practices
  • Experience supporting maintenance planning, shutdowns, and turnaround activities
  • Strong organizational, analytical, and time management skills
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills with strong attention to detail and accuracy
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced manufacturing environment
  • Strong problem-solving and decision-making skills
  • Ability to work independently while contributing to a collaborative cross-functional team environment

job.title: Process Operator
job.description:
Disclaimer: SLB completed the acquisition of ChampionX on July 16, 2025. If selected for this position, your employment will begin with ChampionX and will transition to SLB as part of the planned integration.

We are looking for a Process Operator located in Freeport, Texas. If you are a passionate technical professional who enjoys working in an autonomous, hands-on plant environment and have a proven track record of success, we invite you to apply. This is your opportunity to join a global technology company, driving energy innovation for a balanced planet.

What's In It For You

  • Enjoy paid training while learning from experienced professionals.
  • Opportunity for a long-term, advanced career path in operations, service, sales, or management.
  • Access to best-in-class resources, tools, and technology.
  • Thrive in a company that values sustainability, drives a safety-focused culture, and empowers employees through continuous improvement.
  • Comprehensive benefits package that includes medical, dental, vision, 401(k) with company matching, and more!

What You Will Do

This position is primarily responsible for providing production support to the Freeport, TX plant while maintaining safe operations. This position will require occasional weekend call-outs (including nights and holidays) and will work on a rotating DuPont shift schedule.

Production Operations

  • Be proficient in the use of process equipment.
  • Perform all aspects of manufacturing a product from a process order or bill of material.
  • Operate pumps, valves, scales, and other processing equipment for safe and efficient chemical production.
  • Operate and maintain equipment related to plant utilities and waste treatment.
  • Operate all transporting equipment used to receive raw materials and transport finished products.
  • Effectively load and unload bulk materials from tankers.
  • Make necessary hose line-ups for loading materials from tankers into vessels and vice versa.
  • Prepare drums, pails, totes, and other containers for loading, shipping, and transport of products.
  • Operate scales and maintain the drumming platform.

Production Support and Documentation

  • Operate a computer to perform production functions including generating process orders, inventory checks, label creation, and quality checks.
  • Label and placard packaged materials in accordance with company policy and government regulations.
  • Support processes to meet the requirements of current ISO and Responsible Care standards.
  • Participate in physical inventory activities.
  • May perform required Quality Assurance testing.
  • Be able to act as a second-line Production Planner as needed.

Safety, Environmental, and Equipment Care

  • Maintain a clean, safe, and environmentally compliant work and storage area.
  • Participate in safety meetings and continuous improvement committees.
  • Troubleshoot and repair minor equipment issues and notify maintenance of major repairs.
  • Demonstrate the ability to supervise Assistant Process Operators and Operators.
  • Lead by example through a hands-on approach to safe and efficient operations.
  • Maintain final responsibility for products leaving the plant while supporting a 95% on-time service level.

Pre-Employment Requirements

  • Must successfully complete all pre-employment requirements as applicable.
  • Must be able to meet all site safety requirements.

Position Details

  • Location: Freeport, Texas.
  • Local position based at the Freeport manufacturing plant.
  • Work schedule follows a DuPont rotating shift schedule, including days, nights, weekends, holidays, and overtime as required.
  • Occasional weekend call-outs may be required.

Minimum Qualifications

  • High school diploma or GED.
  • One year of manufacturing experience.
  • Ability to read, write, and speak English.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Team player with the ability to perform physical work.
  • Ability to safely wear a respirator.
  • Ability to wear fall protection when required.
  • Willingness to work weekends.
  • Willingness to work rotating day and night shifts.
  • Ability to lift up to 50 pounds, climb stairs and ladders, squat, bend, and perform physical work throughout the shift.
  • Immigration sponsorship is not offered for this role.

Physical Demands

  • Must have the ability to lift and carry up to 50 pounds, climb stairs and ladders, squat, bend, and perform physically demanding tasks throughout the shift.
  • Role is deemed safety-sensitive and may be subject to employer or customer drug testing.

Working Conditions

  • Work is performed in a chemical manufacturing environment.
  • Exposure to chemicals, noise, heat, humidity, moving equipment, and varying weather conditions.
  • Required use of Personal Protective Equipment (PPE), including respirators, hard hats, safety glasses, gloves, hearing protection, and fall protection as required.
  • Work includes climbing stairs, operating industrial equipment, handling hazardous materials, and working rotating shifts.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Process Technology degree.
  • Transportation experience.
  • Forklift experience.

The Specialist safely operates multiple configuration bulk trucks over congested city highways, rolling and mountainous terrain and rural roads. The Specialist also provides preventative maintenance of any type of vehicle used to deliver chemicals to customers, plants and warehouse locations.

  • Operates the transport unit business to maintain and improve profitability by managing all aspects of operational costs

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Certification in WHMIS, TDG, First Aid and H2S
